summary: Read the complete 13-page chapter markdown through the references; no appendices are present. Independently checked every cited PDF page and the relevant methods, figures and results. All three estimates correctly transcribe their arm means, SDs, p-values and printed r values for personalized versus standard GAI. The abstract explicitly places all 62 students in both tasks, supporting 62 in each arm and 62 unique people; no outcome-specific exclusions or separate analyzed counts are printed. The requested question, construct, measure, higher_is, AI availability, timing, paired-design and comparison codes agree with the methods. No SE or CI is printed for these contrasts, supporting se_basis=not_reported; the observation count and SD level cannot be confirmed. Three unit-code problems remain: null is outside the vocabulary, but the paper does not identify a defensible non-null replacement. No additional in-scope output outcome or reported contrast is missing under extraction rules 4-6: the three creative-performance dimensions are represented, no first-round-only results are reported, and self-efficacy, eye-tracking and within-condition correlations are appropriately excluded.
